item.title: Season 4 opens this weekend
item.dc:creator: FlukRocker
item.content:encoded:
The new season starts Saturday at 18:00. Spawn has been rebuilt and the resource world resets with it.

  • New shop district
  • Higher mob caps
  • Rebalanced economy

item.title: Launcher rewritten on Tauri
item.dc:creator: FlukRocker
item.content:encoded: The launcher no longer ships a browser engine, so the installer went from about 103 MB to 17 MB.
